newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: THAKRAL IN S$12.6 MLN HK, CHINA JV DEALS.
newsitem.headline: THAKRAL IN S$12.6 MLN HK, CHINA JV DEALS.

text.p: Consumer electronics distributor Thakral Corp Ltd said on Thursday it had moved into the software market in Hong Kong and China with three joint venture deals worth a combined Singapore $12.6 million.

"The production and distribution of software products is a natural complement to our distribution activities of hardware products," Thakral managing director Inderbethal Singh Thakral said in a statement.
Distribution of consumer electronics products in China and Hong Kong accounts for about 90 percent of Thakral turnover and about 97 percent of pre-tax profits, the firm said.
Thakral said the deals comprised a joint venture with one of its Hong Kong units and a unit of financial services firm Platinum Securities Co Ltd in DOT Media Holdings (HK) Ltd.
DOT would replicate and distribute software for digital video discs (DVDs), compact discs (CDs), CD-ROM, DVD-ROM and video CDs (VCDs).

A Thakral unit in China had secured distribution and manufacturing rights for VCD, DVD, CD-ROM and other software products by signing two joint venture agreements with China Audio Video Publishing House, the publishing arm of the Chinese Ministry of Culture.
Thakral said the combined manufacturing capability of the three ventures was 48 million discs a year.
Funding for the deals would be through internal resources, but external financing might be sought later when the need arose, the statement said.
